stem: Which parent statement demonstrates correct newborn bath safety?

options.A: I will keep a hand on my baby throughout the bath and check the water temperature before placing the baby in the water
options.B: A supportive infant bath seat makes it safe to step away briefly
options.C: Running water is safest because the temperature stays constant while the baby is in the sink
options.D: If I forget a towel, I can leave the baby in the tub for a moment while I get it

rationale: AAP water-safety guidance recommends continuous touch supervision whenever an infant is in bathwater and checking the water temperature before the bath. Bath seats do not prevent drowning, and water temperature can fluctuate when water is running. If the caregiver must leave, the infant should be taken along rather than left in the water even briefly. Therefore A is the best answer.
educational_objective: Teach continuous touch supervision and pre-checking bathwater temperature to reduce drowning and scald risk during infant bathing.
